title: A vanishing theorem for residual Eisenstein cohomology
summary: We study the residual Eisenstein cohomology of semisimple groups in the context of maximal parabolic subgroups which remain maximal over $\mathbb{R}$. Under certain general hypotheses, we show that these residual representations are cohomological one degree below middle, and one above; however, the classes above middle vanish in the full automorphic cohomology. We offer two proofs of this vanishing, one quick and one more explicit.
